page.layout: One column of running text. Above it, the running head and page number. Within the text, an italic Latin epigram set as an indented block of verse. Below it, a French paragraph and an italic attribution line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: dix-huict & dix-neuf ans. Il y a cent ans que Iulius Cesar Scaliger, grand & subtil Philosophe, aussi bien que tres-sçauant & tres-excellent Medecin, demeurant à Agen, ville de Guyenne, que vous auez appellé vous-mesme Praestantissimum litterarum heroa, se plaint de l'ignorance des nouueaux Docteurs de Montpelier : c'est en ses Poësies Latines, Epiderpidum lib. 3. Le titre de l'Epigramme est, Ignari Medici, aux Ignorans Medecins.

p.i: Mera colluuies scutica subsellia linquens Olida, puerorum calefacta sessione, Statim ubi tetigit vel pede Pessuli tabernas, Et duas modulo, & ordine formulas docentum Olfecit, ab his illico temeraria regnū, Sese in penetrale induit Æsculapiorum. Prauis in nouitatibus ergo deprehensi, Torum tumido gutture sic vociferantur, Quantum Pharicus Perfica iam castra sequutus Clamauit ad Istrum, neque Stentorive cedunt Marti, Diomedis manibusque vulnerato.

main_text.p: Par vn autre Epigramme addressé à l'Eschole de Montpelier, il descrit la friponnerie d'vn Medecin de Montpelier, que l'Eschole souftenoit & approuoit pour sien. C'est en la page 639. ad Montem Pessulum d' Caluo.

p.i: Iean Hucher, natif de Bonnieres prés de Beaunais

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "Perfica" is printed as shown and may be a printing error for "Persica"; kept as printed. "sessione" is read from a long-s form. The italic/roman boundary in the French sentence ending "en la page 639. ad Montem Pessulum d' Caluo." is uncertain. Small dash-like marks in the left margin beside the verses are not printed text and are omitted. The small mark at the foot centre is not text and is omitted.
